AP reports that the cease fire entitles Iran to charge for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, split with Oman, and to use that money for reconstruction. (Prior to the Israeli/US attack, passage through the Strait was free).

apnews.com/live/iran-war-isr…
Truth is starting to dawn on the more unintentionally honest neocons and Israelis:

Lindsey Graham is at least honest enough to admit that he's upset about this outcome and knows the war aims weren't achieved. 

But I hope Trump stays convinced that he won -- or can credibly pretend he believes that -- because that's most likely to end this war permanently.


Lindsey Graham (@LindseyGrahamSC)

Like everyone, I hope we can end the reign of terror of the Iranian regime through diplomacy.

We must remember that the Strait of Hormuz was attacked by Iran after the start of the war,

The Big Victory that Trump points to here is that Iran will open the Strait of Hormuz.

The Strait of Hormuz was completely open before Israel and the US attacked. It was closed only as a response to the war.

So congrats on getting the Strait of Hormuz re-opened. Huge victory.


The Spectator Index (@spectatorindex)

BREAKING: Trump extends deadline by two weeks

If letting Trump and his followers pretend that they won something is necessary to stop the war, let them throw a victory parade for Trump and build another bust in his likeness and just indulge the fantasy for the moment.


Joe Weisenthal (@TheStalwart)

Twitter all day: Omg, he's crazy, he's gonna start WWIII

Twitter now: Lol he TACO'd again!
